finding: the authority service was serving a DIFFERENT saipen tree than the deployed hook
why_it_blocks: host_authority_identity.prove_hook_invocation step 4 refuses with REASON_HOOK_ARTIFACT_MISMATCH when artifact_current(script) is False. The check compares the INSTALLED hook against the SHIPPED artifact under the BROKER's own saipen_root, so a broker running from a stale tree refuses every genuine host hook no matter how correct the deployed hook is.
repair: saipen host repair --json (HOST_REPAIRED) rewrote the broker-side artifact; artifact_current is now True
